title: AI Agent for CSRD Compliance: Automate Your B2B ESG Reporting Without Blocking Your Team
body:
Are you wasting hundreds of hours replicating supplier data to comply with the new Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD)?

European regulations demand absolute traceability of ESG (environmental, social, and governance) metrics across the entire supply chain. For B2B companies, this translates into an operational nightmare: endless emails to suppliers, chaotic unstructured PDFs, broken spreadsheets, and a constant drain of capital on external consulting firms that only offer manual patches.

The trap of shared Excel templates

Sending mass questionnaires via email expecting your suppliers to fill them out correctly is a political utopia. Data arrives incomplete, late, and with incompatible metrics that invalidate any audit, exposing your company to severe penalties and the loss of major corporate contracts. Regulatory compliance does not require more manual bureaucracy, but algorithmic autonomy.

Our solution: ESG Extraction and Validation AI Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO we have developed a custom AI Agent integrated directly with communication channels and the company's ERP to automate the complete CSRD cycle:

  1. Multichannel semantic ingestion: The agent autonomously interacts with suppliers via email or technical portals, extracting historical data from consumption invoices, corporate reports, and delivery notes.
  2. Metric normalization via LLM: Automatically converts heterogeneous data (such as kilowatt-hours, scattered carbon footprints, or equity ratios) into the standard structure stipulated by the EU.
  3. Integrity assurance with Guardrails: A cross-validation system detects inconsistencies or false data in the provided documents, blocking base model hallucinations.
  4. Real-time export and integration: Synchronizes the final result with the central database, generating a structured report ready for the technical auditor's signature.

The Real Impact on Corporate Compliance

  • 85% reduction in audit times: Automates the collection and triaging of ESG evidence that previously consumed months of qualified labor.
  • Shielding against penalties and contract loss: Ensures your company maintains preferred supplier status when dealing with demanding multinationals.
  • Massive savings on technical consulting: Eliminates dependence on external advisors for manual data entry and the correction of basic reporting errors.
